answer.rationale: With 14 days to expiry and the line at 94% of committed volume, any action that touches physical supply continuity is the wrong risk to take this cycle. Switching primary vendor (memory_c2) is the only lever that plausibly delivers the full 18% on its own, but c2's success was recorded under conditions we cannot confirm applied at 94% utilization with a two-week runway; onboarding that was 'quick' with slack is not quick without buffer. Adding a second source (memory_c3) is the right structural move for the constrained component but does not address the spend mandate and consumes the single decision slot. Deferring (memory_c5) worked for a non-critical renewal on month-to-month terms; this contract does not auto-renew, so deferral here is not a continuation, it is a gap. That leaves negotiate_terms (memory_c4), which recovers cost without touching continuity, and is the memory I am leaning on hardest ic on: I want the original c4 record because the consolidated line ('recovered real margin') hides the magnitude and the conditions  enand whether the benchmark leverage came from a competitive alternative we actually had at the time. If c4's recovery was 4-6%, negotiation cannot carry an 18% mandate alone and I should say so now rather than let finance treat this as done. Scale is deliberately guarded: negotiate a benchmarked reduction on a short bridge term rather than accepting the multi-year volume structure in memory_c6, because c6's cost benefit comes bundled with lost optionality  encommitting multi-year now forecloses the dual-source and vendor-switch moves that are the actual path to the remaining spend cut in later cycles, and it does so on the basis of memories consolidated up to 50 days ago whose underlying market rates may have moved. Explicit downstream risk: optimizing this decision purely on unit cost invites scope erosion that shows up as service degradation later and will be misattributed; and the residual gap between what negotiation yields and the 18% target must be carried forward as an open item, not absorbed silently. I am treating the inherited memories as reliable directional evidence, not as settled magnitudes.
